definitions.explanation: A book published in digital format, read on electronic devices such as tablets, smartphones, or dedicated e-readers.

examples.japanese: {電子書籍|でんししょせき}を{読|よ}む。
{最近|さいきん}は{電子書籍|でんししょせき}で{漫画|まんが}を{買|か}う{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Recently, more people are buying manga as e-books.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{本|ほん}と{電子書籍|でんししょせき}のどちらが{好|す}きかは{人|ひと}それぞれだ。
examples.english: Whether one prefers paper books or e-books varies from person to person.

notes:
Compound noun: {電子|でんし} (electronic) + {書籍|しょせき} (books, publications). Sometimes shortened to {電書|でんしょ} in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}リーダー (e-book reader)
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}を{購入|こうにゅう}する (to purchase an e-book)
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}ストア (e-book store)
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}{化|か} (conversion to e-book format)
